gloss: to form; to shape; to mold

definitions.gloss: to form; to shape; to mold
definitions.explanation: To give shape or structure to something, either physically or abstractly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{形作|かたちづく}る。
⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人格|じんかく}→人格：11427_jinkaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{形作|かたちづく}る。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{形作|かたちづく}られてきた。
examples.english: A unique culture has been formed over the course of a long history.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ (shape, form) and ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make). It emphasizes the process of bringing something into a definite shape or structure, whether physical objects or abstract concepts like character, society, or culture.

The passive form {形作|かたちづく}られる is very common, especially when describing how something has been shaped by external forces over time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人格|じんかく}→人格：11427_jinkaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{形作|かたちづく}る: to shape one's character
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{形作|かたちづく}る: to form a culture
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{形作|かたちづく}る: to shape society
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{形作|かたちづく}る: to shape the future

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make — more general; focuses on creation rather than giving shape
- ⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to form — more formal and often used in written or academic contexts
- ⟦{造|つく}る→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧: to build, to construct — emphasizes physical construction
